###Plan

We need to find a pattern that relates $x$ to $y$.

The terms in sequence $y$ are $\redE{?}$ more or $\redE{?}$ less than the terms in sequence $x$.

$y = x +{\redE{?}}$

or

$y = x - {\redE{?}}$

We see that $y$ is *less* than $x$ in every row, so we subtract to get $y$.

$x$ | $y$ | Difference
:-: | :-: | :-:
$25$ | $20$  |$25\redE{-{?}}=20$
$22$ | $17$  |$22\redE{-{?}}=17$
$19$ | $14$ |$19\redE{-{?}}=14$

What value for $\redE{?}$ makes all the equations true?

$x$ | $y$ | Difference
:-: | :-: | :-:
$25$ | $20$  |$25\redE{-5}=20$
$22$ | $17$  |$22\redE{-5}=17$
$19$ | $14$ |$19\redE{-5}=14$

The terms in pattern $y$ are $\redE{5}$ *less* than the terms in pattern $x$.

###Answer

The terms in pattern $y$ are $5$ less than the terms in pattern $x$.
